General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The main achievements in 2012: Partner organisations have advocated for changes in the law related to funding of safe houses. They have managed to revise the law in RS, so that the municipalities also need to contribute to the funding of safe houses and therefore moved the responsibilities to local level, For the first time Kvinna till Kvinna has supported a project which gave nonheterosexual women with double discrimination a voice in the book published about lesbian women’s coming out stories. Kvinna till Kvinna’s work with the peace building issues has opened up a dialogue within and among partner organisations who started projects aiming to empower women in are now dealing with the past and transitional justice. The watchdog role of partners organisations have been noticeably strengthened owing to the Women network which established itself as an important and visible platform for advocating women’s rights.
